paragraphs: Hi, I'm Shakirul Hasan Khan — a software engineer and builder from Bangladesh. I've spent 5+ years shipping full-stack products, AI features, and tools I actually wanted to exist.

I currently engineer Ramble, an AI network-intelligence product, and I'm on the founding team at Thinking Lab in Sylhet, where we're building HealthERP and custom software for ambitious businesses. In 2025 I founded Ponno, an AI sales agent for Facebook-first merchants.

I also write Montu Mia's System Design, a Bengali-first (now also English) storytelling series that sneaks system design into a character's slightly chaotic life. 3,000+ subscribers, 30,000+ readers, 147 GitHub stars, and Montu still hasn't shipped to production.
I work mostly in TypeScript, React, Next.js, Python, and Rust. Always building something slightly too ambitious.
